contexts.text: I will Judge = visitation and Judgment.
Visitation does not come until the evil (of the Church) has been consummated; that is, when there is no longer any good of charity and truth of faith. AC 2141.
I will go down, and see = visitation.

The last time of the Church in general, and that of each person in particular, is called in the Word visitation, and precedes the Judgment: thus visitation is nothing else than an examination of quality.
By visitation, as mentioned in the Word, is signified either vastation... or deliverance; thus the examination of the quality. Illustrated.
There came two Angels to Sodom in the evening = the visitation which precedes the Judgment.
In this chapter () there is described the act of visitation itself, and then the Judgment.
Evening = the time of visitation. Explained, Illustrated.
The first time of the visitation. Signified, Explained.
Jehovah visited Sarah () = the presence of the Divine Celestial in the Divine Spiritual... To visit = to be present.
The same time is called the year of visitation. Illustrated. (And the day of visitation. AC 5360:2.)

God in visiting will visit you () = that the last time will come... that is, the last time of the old Church, and the first of the new. This last time is called in the Word visitation, which is predicated... both of the new Church which is being born, and of the old Church which is expiring; and, in particular, both of a man of the Church who is being saved, and of one who is being condemned. Illustrated. AC 6591.
To visit = to deliver.
The day of visitation () = the advent of the Lord, and enlightenment then; but, relatively to the Jewish nation... the last time of the representatives of the Church with them.
Visitation = retribution, thus condemnation. Illustrated.

Visiting I have visited you () = His advent to those of the Spiritual Church; for to visit = the advent of the Lord, which precedes the last time of the Church, which time, in the Word, is called the Last Judgment. Illustrated.
Thus in visiting to visit = deliverance from falsities, and thus initiation into the things of the Lord's Church and Kingdom.

Jehovah hath visited the sons of Israel () = that those of the Spiritual Church were delivered and saved by the advent of the Lord; for to visit = deliverance by means of the advent of the Lord into the world; thus also Salvation.
Their condemnation (there) does not take place until they have been visited, that is, examined.
The state and quality of the Law from the Divine, with those of the Spiritual Church, at the first time of visitation. Signified.
To visit the iniquity of the fathers () = the prolification of evils.

In the day of My visitation, I will visit upon them their sin () = their last state in particular and in general when is the Judgment; for the day of visitation = the last state of the Church in particular and in general; and to visit sin = to be judged and condemned. It is said in particular and in genera], because the day of visitation happens to everyone... when he comes into the other life... and also to the Church in general, when it ceases to be...

At the consummation (of the Church) its visitation takes place; and when visitation is effected, all who are in evil are rejected, and all who are in good are received. Visitation takes place in the other life, where all are together...
Visiting the iniquity of the fathers... () = the rejection and condemnation of evils...

The reason visitation = casting out and damnation, is that this follows the consummation of evils, and precedes the condemnation itself which is meant by the Last Judgment; for visitation is the examination of the quality of the man; but it takes place in the other life...
(A visitation in the World of Spirits.) Described.
The writing on the wall, and the death of Belshazzar = visitation and destruction...

After visitation, destruction took place; for visitation always precedes. Visitation is the examination of their quality, and is also the separation of the good from the evil, the good being taken away, and the evil left.
On the signs and visitations before the Last Judgment. General article.

Visitations were made by Angels; for visitation always precedes the perishing of any badly ordered Society. The Angels exhorted them to desist... and examined them to see whether any good [Spirits] were intermingled among them: these they separated. The crowd attacked the Angels, just as at Sodom.
Preachers visit the maidens there, and examine them.
That if not, when visitation comes, they will be dispersed. Signified.
To come quickly = visitation, because the advent of the Lord into the world = visitation. Visitation is the examination of man after death to [determine] his quality, before he is judged.
Steadfastness in a state of the good of love and of faith, even to visitation. Signified.
Till I come = visitation.
It is said to visit () instead of to judge, because visitation always precedes Judgment.
To visit () = to destroy, because visitation precedes Judgment...
The visitation which precedes the Last Judgment. Signified.
The days of visitation, and of retribution () = the days of the Last Judgment, when the evil suffer penalties, which is the retribution that is always preceded by visitation.
The mode of visitation, that is, of the exploration of the quality of the Church as to truth and as to good. Signified, Explained.

The reason a reed = visitation, is that visitation is the exploration of the quality of the men of the Church; and because visitation precedes the Last Judgment. The nature of this visitation or exploration is evident from the visitation in Sodom. Explained.
A reed = Divine truth in the ultimate of order... by (which) and its power all visitation, or exploration, is effected. Explained.
The visitation of the natural man from Divine truth spiritual natural. Signified. For visitation is examination into what a man is, and the examination is effected by means of Divine truth.
Announcement after exploration or visitation. Signified, Explained. AE 917.
Visitation is mentioned in many passages, and it = an exploration of what the state of the Church is before the judgment. Not that such visitation actually occurs. Explained.
